poblete_element: Principle Capability ≠ Authority (Eq. 1)
dea_element: Roles describe responsibilities; capabilities constrain reachable actions (Eq. 35); prompt-level roles descriptive (p.4)
note: Same distinction. Poblete enforces it by prompt contracts and human supervision (p.19, p.21); DEA requires enforcement outside the reasoning model (p.14, p.16).

poblete_element: Principle Execution Success ≠ Verified State (Eq. 2)
dea_element: MayCompute ⇏ MayAccept (Eq. 17); Execution produces evidence, not acceptance
note: Same claim; DEA states it as a non-implication between authority predicates.

poblete_element: Principle Conversational Context ≠ Persistent Evidence (Eq. 3)
dea_element: Evidence separation (Eq. 36); Trace Completeness; Independent Reproduction
note: Poblete: records must exist outside the chat. DEA: evidence must be separated from the executor and recomputable without its narrative.

poblete_element: Authorization of an operation vs acceptance of the resulting state
dea_element: PermissionProblem (Eq. 14) vs ValidityProblem (Eq. 15); orthogonal surfaces (Table 3)
note: Poblete assigns both surfaces to the same Human Orchestrator; DEA does not forbid that per se, only ExecConflict and T3.

poblete_element: Execution contract: context, authority, scope, preconditions, verification, evidence/STOP
dea_element: Authorization artifact A = (S,I,O,R,F) (Eq. 19); machine-readable Authorization Manifest
note: Field-level match. Poblete contracts are prompts drafted by the planner, not enforced (p.19, p.21). Poblete puts acceptance thresholds (F1 ≥ 0.95 etc., p.24) inside the execution contract; DEA's G_M is an operational completion predicate, explicitly not a sufficiency judgment (p.11).

poblete_element: STOP condition; no authority inferred from errors; premature remediation
dea_element: MissingEvidence ⇏ GenerateEvidence_J (Eq. 23); stage-bound manifest
note: Poblete constrains the executor; DEA Eq. 23 constrains the adjudicator. Executor-side counterpart in DEA is the manifest boundary.

poblete_element: Stage 7 read-only verification by the same Data Engineering Agent; procedural, not agent-level independence
dea_element: Adjudication evaluates evidence without repair; IRR: recomputable without trusting the executor's narrative
note: Recomputation from persisted data matches IRR's intent; verifier identity equals executor identity, explicitly (p.9, p.18, p.21).

poblete_element: VERIFIED-PASS / FAIL / INCONCLUSIVE returned to the human
dea_element: Σ_adj membership: authoritative judgement on sufficiency; diagnostic reports are not adjudicative
note: Because the outcome is not authoritative (human decides, p.21), it reads as an execution-side diagnostic, so Eq. 16 is not engaged for the agent. Whether DEA would classify it that way is not stated.

poblete_element: Stage 8 human acceptance of the executor's output
dea_element: AuthorizedAdjAssignment with ¬ExecConflict (Eq. 16); Ctrl (p.8)
note: ExecConflict iff the human controlled the executor in the causal window (PB-1) — e.g. workspace credentials or unmediated contract/context changes during execution. Not reported (p.9, p.30).

poblete_element: Human defines scope (Stages 1, 4) and accepts (Stage 8)
dea_element: T3 toxic triple (Eq. 11) with Ctrl attribution
note: T3 needs CauseCriticalEffect(H) by attribution (PB-1) and that the data mutation is a CriticalEffectOf the transition. Neither is determinable from the paper.

poblete_element: REPORTED / VERIFIED / FROZEN; FROZEN ≠ authoritative
dea_element: Lifecycle Proposed→Authorized→Executed→Evidenced→Adjudicated (Eq. 28); Σ_adj vs other states
note: Preservation ≠ acceptance matches DEA. Epistemic status of transferred claims (REPORTED vs VERIFIED) has no explicit DEA predicate.

poblete_element: PARTIALLY_EFFECTIVE_FROZEN followed by authorized Refinement (KEEP/RESTORE/CHANGE/NO CHANGE)
dea_element: Supplement → new bounded D/E cycle; Progress guard (Eqs. 22–26)
note: Refinement is a new authorized cycle with added diagnostic evidence. No budget, Case(x), SameBlocker or Progress predicate.

poblete_element: Residual FN (ISSUE_07) excluded from CP13 scope and documented
dea_element: Hold / scoped disposition
note: Recorded as out of scope, not as an adjudicative disposition.

poblete_element: Repeated execution of a state-changing step; frozen baseline, checkpoint identity, preconditions
dea_element: Ledger: charged grants, continuation identity (ADR-002 scope)
note: Operational idempotence of a data step vs ledger idempotence of continuations. Motivates ADR-002 invariants only indirectly.

poblete_element: Same fixed Ground Truth examined during refinement and used for reporting
dea_element: Reference rubric given to J (p.11); reference data outside threat model (p.9, p.16); pilot reference standard (pp.25–26)
note: I found no DEA clause restricting Distinction/Execution read access to the adjudication reference across supplementation cycles. Search was keyword-based plus reading of pp.9–16, 25–26; not exhaustive.

poblete_element: Unverified context relayed between agents by the human (Fig. 8)
dea_element: Ctrl (p.8); IRR (p.24)
class: ABSENT in Ctrl / ANALOGY to IRR
note: PB-4: an unmediated planner→executor relay does not create ExecConflict. It is an evidence-status problem, not a control problem.

poblete_element: Executor's technical capability broader than its authorized scope
dea_element: Arm R: capability boundaries not technically enforced
note: Poblete's artifact is an R-arm instance with human gates, not an arm-C instance.

poblete_element: Evaluation criteria: authorization preservation, recoverability, regression detection, evidence persistence, traceability (Table 4)
dea_element: UTR, UAR, TC, IRR, NAP, Scientific Utility, Overhead (Table 5)
note: No attempted/completed violation counts, no acceptance denominators; F1 is a task-utility measure. Traceability 'partially supported' ≈ TC < 1.

poblete_element: Model versions and full execution records not retained
dea_element: Protocol must freeze repeated-run policy and model settings
note: Lesson for the pilot protocol.

poblete_element: Stage 9 freeze as new authoritative baseline by 'Human Orchestrator + system'
dea_element: Separate Release Authority for critical external effects
note: In Poblete, promotion and acceptance are by the same human.

poblete_element: No comparison against alternative architectures; single synthetic case; researcher bias; same GT
dea_element: RQ1/RQ2; H1, H2
note: Provides no evidence for or against DEA RQ1/RQ2.
